from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProvidedPaper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection with its title and citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that reference this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    provided_papers: list[ProvidedPaper]
